Agent Name: Engineer, Alex
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Engineer (Alex) made a critical logical error in the implementation of the topological sort algorithm. Specifically, the queue initialization was set to include courses with `indegree[i] > 0` instead of `indegree[i] == 0`. This means the algorithm starts processing courses that have prerequisites rather than those that have none, which is the fundamental requirement for topological sorting. Additionally, the logic for updating indegrees and the graph construction was flawed (e.g., `indegree[ai] += 1` instead of tracking prerequisites correctly for the source node). These errors would cause the function to return an incorrect order or fail to handle cases with cycles properly, leading to a wrong solution for the real-world problem of course scheduling.
